name: GPU Splat Rasterization via Vertex/Fragment Shaders
definition: An implementation of splat rasterization on GPUs that simulates a dedicated rasterization unit using standard graphics pipeline stages: vertex shaders for transformation and bounding box calculation, point primitives for fragment generation, and fragment shaders for kernel evaluation and depth computation.
summary: GPU Splat Rasterization via Vertex/Fragment Shaders efficiently projects 3D splats by using standard graphics pipeline stages to achieve accurate depth and filtering with minimal fragment shader instructions.
